scope: Bounded MVP metadata reuse in existing value slots. Ordinary native release, fat LTO, one codegen unit; no native-profile feature in timings. Full-process CPU/wall samples include construction, input, checksums, and teardown. System-allocation counters are confined to the separate diagnostic binary. No whole-document or Wasm-runtime claim.
commands: python3 benchmarks/memory.py --umber target/token-metadata/umber --allocations target/token-metadata/allocations --baseline target/token-metadata/baseline/umber --baseline-allocations target/token-metadata/baseline/allocations --repeats 7 --report target/token-metadata/final-memory.json

python3 benchmarks/mvp.py --umber target/token-metadata/umber --baseline target/token-metadata/baseline/umber --cases parameters groups delimiters --sizes 1000000 --repeats 9 --report target/token-metadata/final-long.json

layout.scope: Offsets in measured x86-64 Rc slots. repr(C) orders Definition fields; no code relies on Vec internals or these numeric offsets. Ordinary delimiter fallback uses one checked flat-array index; native-profile retains its cached immutable slice.

limitations: Core CPU regression remains, including the longer parameter and delimiter confirmations; broader CPU is near flat.
Focused metadata counts include setup; their warm plateau does not establish allocation-free execution everywhere.
Each slot retains metadata high-water capacity; growing the live header set still allocates individual Rc records. Live-growth memory is larger.
Backing token block caches retain their existing bounds. Metadata/header slab density remains future work.

kernels.name: spelling
kernels.adaptation: Definitions unchanged. Bootstrap ifcanspell with let instead of loading plain newif. The preceding aesthetic macro needs an accent and is omitted.

kernels.name: today
kernels.adaptation: Definition unchanged. Define plain's space macro and assign calendar parameters explicitly.

kernels.name: talks
kernels.adaptation: Definition unchanged. Consume expanded sentences in definitions rather than typesetting them.

kernels.name: contentsentry
kernels.adaptation: Retain the complete write payload in a parameterized macro invoked in edef. Stringified line/dotfill names and braces are never executed. Bootstrap pageno with countdef.

kernels.name: maketable
kernels.adaptation: Retain the bracketed-title and paragraph-delimited signature; replace the box/display body with edef of both complete payloads.

broader.validation: Every record compares its expanded definition with independently generated expected tokens; comparison and expected definition construction are timed.
broader.storage: Immutable definitions and token lists are reclaimed after their last semantic owner; bump chunks and value IDs are reused. Interned names remain session-owned.

memory.scope: Full-process CPU/wall medians; allocator requests cover engine construction/execution and exclude the compact host input. Heap peaks are requested bytes, not RSS. pdfTeX memory is not measured by this adapter.
